goal: Find the best model at every fit-time limit on the full Chelsea + West Village data, preferring simpler ones, from short exploration fits confirmed overnight by full fits.

tiers.name: exploration
tiers.description: A short fit (fewer draws, sometimes a subset of buildings) to rank designs quickly; it counts on the research frontier but is never served.

tiers.name: full
tiers.description: Full draws, the convergence gate and the 2-hour cap; full-data confirmation fits run only between 03:00 and 08:00 ET. Only these can be served.

notes: The first full-data fit that passes the gate: bath and floor slopes per building with the served features and the neighbourhood, 2 x (300 + 4,500) draws, 2,800 s.
Calibration of short fits against it is running.
